Il polso del bambino ha molte strutture: The child's wrist has many normal radiolucent structures: the physes of the radius and ulna, the spaces between the ossification centers of the carpus (which appear at different ages) and the space between epiphysis and metaphysis. Before saying "fracture", check that the line is not a physis (regular, symmetric bands in a typical location) and compare the thickness of the physes with each other. The most frequent finding not to be missed is the torus fracture: follow the cortical outline in both projections. A negative radiograph does not exclude an occult fracture (scaphoid, nondisplaced Salter-Harris I): if pain persists, re-examine.
Una linea radiotrasparente nel polso del: A radiolucent line in a child's wrist is first of all a physis: a fracture only if it interrupts the cortex or if the physis is widened or slipped.
